messages:
amelia: Quick heads-up — I'm refreshing the 'hello minimal' quickstart to make onboarding less noisy. Opening a PR in ~10m. Two quick decisions: keep both API_KEY and OIDC auth examples, or pick one canonical path? Also the current deploy snippet references now.sh which is ancient. :thinking:

nina: I'd vote for one canonical path + a short note about alternatives. API_KEY is simplest for quickstarts. OIDC in a separate advanced 'security' note? :+1:

jason: Agree with nina. For first-run we should optimize for lowest friction. API_KEY with env var example is fine. If we show OIDC, it's a whole tangent and triggers infra/security review cycles.

amelia: OK. I'll convert the OIDC section into a "When you scale/enterprise" callout and link to a deeper guide.

marco: About the deploy snippet — we have two flavors in the repo: a Docker+docker-compose example and a Vercel static server example. Which one do you want in quickstart?

amelia: Leaning Vercel for JS users and a tiny serverless note for Python. Want the snippet to be copy-paste-first-run.

liam: Security note: if we recommend API_KEY in quickstart, please include an explicit callout to not hardcode keys (use env vars / secrets manager). Short 1-liner and link to our secrets doc should be enough. Also add a short sample for rotating keys.

amelia: Good call — will add a 1-liner and link.

jason: Small nit — the code sample uses PROCESS.ENV (uppercase) in a couple places and that's inconsistent with our other docs which use process.env. Also uses `fetch` with no error handling; we usually include minimal try/catch for Node examples.

amelia: Thanks, that'll get fixed in the PR.

marco: For the Vercel snippet, can you switch the deploy example from now.sh to vercel CLI + one-liner? e.g.:

```bash
# build + deploy for a tiny express wrapper
vercel --prod --confirm
```

Keep the Docker compose example in the repo but link to it as "self-hosted".

amelia: Yep. I'll replace the now.sh lines and add both links.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created — https://deploy-preview-892--docs.redwood.ai.html (auto comment)

nina: I'll review the PR for clarity and tone, focus on the copy that surfaces for first-timers. If you want, I can also run the quickstart locally after changes and send a screenshot for the README.

amelia: That would be awesome. Thanks! I'll tag you in the PR.

liam: One more: include a one-liner about quotas/rate limits for free tier (link to pricing). New users often hit rate limits during quick tests and get confused.

amelia: Added. Final checklist for the PR: canonical API_KEY example using process.env, Vercel deploy snippet, short security callout + link, replace now.sh references, move OIDC to advanced guide, add rate-limits note. Will ping when ready for review. :rocket:
